67a026.evidence: Confirmed SQL injection vulnerability in email parameter. Payload ' OR 1=1-- successfully bypasses authentication and returns valid JWT token for admin user. Report: vuln-0001

82315b.evidence: Confirmed boolean-based SQL injection in search parameter. Payload ' OR '1'='1 returns all 46 products instead of search results. Report: vuln-0002

dc91eb.evidence: SQL injection enables authentication bypass. Covered in vuln-0001.

ff607a.evidence: JWT uses RS256 (asymmetric, appropriate). No alg=none, no HS256, no JWKS header injection observed. Token verification successful on API endpoints. No weaknesses found in JWT implementation itself.

f9f35f.evidence: Tested registration endpoint with SQLi payloads in email and username fields. All payloads returned 500 status code without processing. No successful SQLi demonstrated.

691fa5.evidence: Tested password reset endpoint with SQLi payloads. All requests returned 500 status. No successful exploitation found.

999e32.evidence: Tested API endpoints with SQLi payloads in query parameters. All requests returned 200 status with expected results. No SQL error messages or unexpected behavior observed.

ed7bc7.evidence: Unauthenticated PUT requests return 200 OK and persist product modifications. Tested by updating product description and verifying changes via subsequent GET request.

2ae824.evidence: XSS payloads are reflected in error page title tags. Example: GET /rest/search?q=%3Csvg%20onload%3Dalert(1)%3E returns 500 error with payload in title tag

10a56b.evidence: Public product catalog is accessible without authentication. This is expected behavior for e-commerce application. No sensitive information exposed beyond public product data.

647938.evidence: Product reviews are public and accessible without authentication. This is expected behavior for e-commerce application.

7680cc.evidence: DELETE requests return 401 Unauthorized, requiring authentication. This endpoint is properly protected.

983a10.evidence: User registration endpoint properly accepts unauthenticated requests (expected behavior). No authorization bypass found.
